'''Taquito''' ({{Pronounced|ʈaqɪʈo}}) was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Iego was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Before leaving, the Separatists left a [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|laser grid system]] over Iego that destroyed all [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that attempted to leave the planet. Taquito was one of the many pilots who tried to break through the grid, but his ship was destroyed, resulting in his [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Can't hold on much&hellip; Someone help me! Arghhh&hellip;|Taquito's last words|audio=TaquitosLastWords-MysteryOfAThousandMoons.flac|<ref name="TCWMoons" />}}
The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Taquito lived during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. At some point, he became friends with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|youth]] [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]], who also lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Some time after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TCWMoons" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded Iego and used it as a base before leaving some time later. When they abandoned Iego, the Separatists installed a [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|laser grid]] around the planet that destroyed all [[Starship/Legends|ships]] attempting to leave Iego. The people of Iego believed the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] grid to be a [[Deity/Legends|god]] that they named [[Drol/Legends|Drol]]. Many [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] tried to navigate through the grid, but they were all unsuccessful, and their ships were destroyed. Taquito also attempted to leave Iego, but like those before him, his ship was hit by the grid. He managed to transmit a last-minute distress call but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when his craft exploded from the damage done by the grid.<ref name="TCWMoons" />

During the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the Clone Wars,<ref name="ERC" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traveled to Iego to find a cure for the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]], a deadly disease re-created by the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]]. After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] did so, they tried to leave Iego but were forced to return to the planet because of the laser field. A citizen named [[Amit Noloff/Legends|Amit Noloff]] showed the Jedi a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Taquito's death to prove to them that Drol was not a myth. With the help of Jaybo Hood, the Jedi were able to [[Mission to Iego/Legends|destroy]] the laser grid, allowing the inhabitants of Iego to leave at their discretion.<ref name="TCWMoons" />

==Personality and traits==
A Rodian and a friend of Jaybo Hood, Taquito attempted to make it through the grid, but like many others, he was killed by the laser grid.<ref name="TCWMoons" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taquito first appeared in a hologram in "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]," the eighteenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[February 13]], [[2009]].<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode018.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>
